name: python3
purpose: Run the Python 3 interpreter to execute a Python script line by line.
explanation: As taught in C07, `python3` itself is an executable program (typically `/usr/bin/python3`). Running `python3 hello.py` involves two programs: the Python interpreter and your script, translating and executing one line at a time.

parameters.description: Path to the Python source file.

explanationOfOutput: The Python interpreter reads, translates, and executes each statement in `hello.py`.
whenToUse: To execute Python scripts or launch an interactive Python session.
commonMistakes: Assuming the CPU executes Python directly without an interpreter.
commonErrors: python3: can't open file 'hello.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
